item.title: Final: Green Bay Packers 20 — New York Jets 17 (Final/OT); QB Geno Smith: 27-of-41 for 247 yards, 1 TD (to Garrett Wilson), 0 INT, 90.2 passer rating; WR Adonai Mitchell: 6 catches for 63 yards; WR Garrett Wilson: 5 catches for 57 yards and a TD; RB Breece Hall: 16 carries for 29 yards, plus 5 catches for 63 yards; Jets defense held Green Bay to 199 total yards and 1-of-9 on third down; HC Aaron Glenn: called it a tough way to lose, saying the team has things to fix
